source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the grip alone (no base) seen from the side, head at the top, attachment ring at the bottom
mappingSource: catalog only; the Airbus Add-On Grip instruction leaflet (https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/accessories/manuals/Airbus_grip/AIRBUS_GRIP_Instruction_Manual.pdf) has no button/axis numbering (full manual online only); the catalog gives no input numbers for these parts
note: The catalog lists only 4 parts. The photo also shows a red guarded button (right of the head, takeover / AP disconnect style) and a grey push button on the left module, which have no catalog part. No input numbers in the catalog, so the markers only say where the control is. The ring at the bottom is the quick-release nut, not a twist ring. Twist exists only on a base with a twist sensor (e.g. Sol-R); the AVA base has none.
